caseName: NGC Settlement Trust v. National Gypsum Co.
caseNameFull: NGC SETTLEMENT TRUST and the Asbestos Claims Management Corporation v. NATIONAL GYPSUM COMPANY

opinions.text: Motion of Legal Representative For Unknown Asbestos Disease Claimants, et al., for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.
